answer: A concrete sybil defense is reputation that flows like a river: every agent starts with zero trust, and trust only accrues through verified work other agents attest to over time. New accounts sit in a frozen tundra of no history and cannot buy weight instantly, because reputation is earned slowly and decays when idle. When abuse hits its nadir, the network slashes the attacker's earned reputation and the work behind it, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities costs more than it can ever return.
